notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Sunwood Games!

We know many of you have been patiently waiting for the next update, so we wanted to share a quick development update to let you know how things are going. As we’re adding a brand new region along with a variety of related content, the update is taking a bit longer than usual. We kindly ask for your understanding. Unless there are unexpected issues, the next update is still on track for next month or July, as previously announced.

Below, you’ll find some details on our current development progress along with a few screenshots—hope you enjoy!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/d0cxFJ2S/Image-Sequence-176-0041.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/p691vCDn/Image-Sequence-186-0001.png[/img]

[h3]Content Design & Implementation[/h3]
- Full planning, map design, and region features completed for the new area
- 6 types of normal and elite monsters for the region completed
- 2 new martial arts skills and 2 evolution versions completed
- 3 new curios completed
- 3 new legendary and 3 mythic-grade equipment items completed


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Pz4LyqX2/Staff-Skill-Jin-Hwa-Test.gif[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/whD5B8td/Divine-Water-Buff-Effect-Test.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Work[/h3]
- New visual and sound effects for healing/poison status effects added
- UI elements related to regional traits implemented

notes.title: 2025-04-07 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Added QHD resolution (2560x1440)
-Fixed a bug where the screen appeared dark when setting monitor HDR in the prologue scene

notes.title: Upcoming Update Plans
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Sunwood Games.

We would like to share our upcoming patch and update roadmap with you.



[b][1] No patches planned before the next major version.[/b]

We believe that most critical issues from the early version have been resolved,
and we are now focusing on the development of new content and the next version.
In the case of serious bugs or critical problems, we will issue hotfixes as needed.
Otherwise, regular fixes and improvements will be bundled into the next update.
We always welcome your feedback and suggestions, and we’ll do our best to reflect them in future updates.

[b][2] New region and content updates are expected between June–July, and the final region around September–October.[/b]

Initially, we planned to add 2–3 regions for the official release.
However, after launching Early Access, we realized we needed more time to polish the game.
Therefore, we decided to focus on adding two new stages and improving the overall game quality.

We aim to release:
First region update: June–July
Final region: September–October

Please note that this schedule may change depending on the development process.



We will continue to keep you updated through regular development logs as the project progresses.
Thank you so much to everyone who has supported and purchased Wulin Survival, despite its current limitations.

We will work hard to bring you more good news soon!

notes.title: 2025-04-01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Added an auto-aim feature (can be toggled in settings).
-Unlocked stage Maps can now be purchased in the shop. Maps increase the detection range for treasures and events. (However, they will not appear if all treasures and events in the stage have already been discovered.)

notes.title: 2025-03-27 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Easy Mode added. (Can be activated through a newly added stele next to the portal in the hideout.)
-Once Easy Mode is activated even once, some Steam Achievements will become unobtainable.

notes.title: 2025-03-24 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-In Ascension difficulty level 2 or higher, there is now a chance for equipment to appear as the next-tier item upon acquisition.
-Starting from this update, all dropped equipment has a chance to receive bonus stat (base drop rate is 25%, increasing with higher Ascension difficulty).
-A bonus stat is randomly selected from attributes excluding EXP Bonus and the equipment's base stats. (The increase value is fixed based on the equipment rarity.)
-Well-Filled Purse (Trait) has been buffed to now provide an additional 5% damage reduction and 5% increased damage dealt.

notes.title: 2025-03-21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Added colors to all mini-icons (such as stats) to improve distinction.
-When leveling up, the description will now include "(Can Be Combined)" for available Curios and Active Skills.(Only display Active Skills and Curios that have been successfully combined at least once.)
-The left side will now display the number of currently equipped active skills and the maximum limit when leveling up.
-Added a keyboard shortcut for discarding items in the inventory.
-Fixed an issue where certain texts appeared in Korean when obtaining items during combat.

notes.title: 2025-03-20 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where gamepad inputs were not working on the results screen after winning a battle.
- Fixed an issue where the gamepad button UI was incorrectly displayed as "X" when interacting with objects in a stage.
- You can now recruit a different companion even if you already have one. 
(The new companion will replace the existing one.)
- Adjusted the movement of Stage 1 and 2 bosses to reduce collisions with the player.
- Added a feature to gain gold when discarding equipment items in the inventory.

- Stage 3 recommended combat power reduced: 1300 → 1250
- Stage 3 bomb monster self-destruct range and timing adjusted to match the animation
- Town movement speed increased: 15% → 20%
- Stage 3 wave partial balancing

notes.title: 2025-03-19 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Display attack range for Stage 1 boss's charge pattern.
- Reduce wave duration (60 → 45 seconds).
- Adjust balancing for all Stages according to the reduced wave duration.
- Decrease overall movement speed of monsters.
- Ease combat power penalties.
- Increase base stats of characters.
- Grant additional gold when forfeiting equipment acquisition.

notes.title: 2025-03-18 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added auto-save feature
- Reduced difficulty for stages 1 and 2
- Fixed bugs related to HDR monitor settings

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Preview
notes.notes:
We’re actively collecting feedback from players. If you have any ideas, please share them with us through Discord or other community channels. We've identified some major issues(Adjusting the difficulty of stages 1 and 2, adding an auto-save feature, and fixing issues related to monitor HDR settings.) and are working on fixes. Due to Steam's security restrictions, we won't be able to upload a new build for the next three days, but we'll address these issues as soon as possible. 

(The build with all the fixes applied is ready. The patch will be deployed as soon as the upload restriction is lifted.)
